title: Out here in orbit / first cosmic expansion
prompt:
Seven-second continuous cosmic wide matching the illustrated starting frame. Turquoise and peach living world below-left with dark blue rock islands and branching coastal light patterns; deep indigo-violet stars remain distant. Very gentle coherent orbital camera drift with visible slow surface/cloud movement, planet remains round and stable. From source 1.0 to 3.0 seconds a soft cyan/amber pulse travels outward along the existing sparse curves from the branching coast around the planetary limb. From 3.0 through 6.0 seconds a tiny bright traveling point continues outward along the long arc into space. Keep line paths sparse, elegant and stable rather than stretching planet geography. Background stars almost stationary at astronomical distance. Natural ongoing motion through handles. No newly invented ship, person, moons, HUD, text, audio, hard cut, zoom blur or wormhole. Keep the graphic-novel texture and beautiful warm upper-right light.

PROMPT LOCK: Cinematic painterly graphic-novel space adventure. Harper is the established adult freckled woman with curly auburn hair, gray short-sleeve tee, gray trousers and bare feet. Ship: ultra-thin clear spherical technological field with faint curved cyan geodesic lines, dark satin metal equatorial band and upper/lower circular platforms, continuous amber rim lights, sparse rectangular cyan lamps, one aft vertical open engine ring with cyan inner arc when visible. Background Moon A is charcoal volcanic basalt/orange fissures and Moon B pale cyan ice/blue fractures when the angle includes them; neither is attached to the cabin or camera. Upper-right sunlight. Preserve complete metal geometry, no thick glass, bubble refraction, unrelated HUD, English text, logos or watermark. The authored navigation shot may contain a diegetic volumetric schematic and sparse invented glyphs, with enlarged celestial icons and compressed schematic spacing.
